purpose: Test whether current pre-race M3 adds probability information on top of the market-independent Ability-derived coherent wide baseline without adding a high-dimensional combiner.

formula.baseline: P0(S) proportional to exp(sum(theta_i for i in S)), |S|=3, theta chosen to reproduce Ability Top3 marginals
formula.m3_strength: m_i = -(M3_score_i - race_mean_M3_score) / race_sd_M3_score; higher is better because lower runtime M3 score ranks better
formula.candidate: P_gamma(S) proportional to exp(sum(theta_i for i in S) + gamma * sum(m_i for i in S))
formula.wide_probability: q_ij = sum(P_gamma(S) for S containing i and j)
formula.gamma_selection: one scalar gamma selected on 2024 only by minimizing Top3-set negative log likelihood
formula.coherence: Every candidate distribution still contains exactly three horses, therefore sum of all wide pair probabilities remains exactly 3. M3 is allowed to update the Ability marginals.

evaluation_universe_note: Reconstructed from locally supplied TARGET-style data with normalized horse names, actual available starters >=12, and races having exactly three Top3 labels. Ability/M3 features use strictly prior data. Counts are close to but not identical to every frozen source model universe; treat as Research/Shadow evidence only.

decision.reason: M3 gives small, directionally consistent LogLoss/Brier/calibration improvements in both 2025 and 2026, but the race-cluster bootstrap intervals still include zero and AUC is slightly lower in both untouched years. Evidence is promising but not strong enough to replace the Ability-only baseline.
decision.next_step: Keep gamma=0.12708213 frozen as a Shadow challenger and compare it prospectively against the Ability-only baseline. Do not tune gamma again on 2025/2026 results.
